recipes.name: Alton Brown’s Smoked Paprika Chicken and Potatoes
steps: Heat oven to 375°F
Chop olives; mix with lemon zest and garlic; set aside
Stir paprika, olive oil, half the salt, and pepper into a paste
Cut the bones out of the thighs with kitchen shears, keeping the skin on
Push about 2 tbsp olive mixture under each thigh’s skin; rub paste on top
Spread thinly sliced potatoes and onion on a foil-lined sheet pan; sprinkle with remaining salt
Set chicken skin-up on a rack over the potatoes; bake 55–60 min
For crispier potatoes, remove the rack and bake 5–10 min more

recipes.name: Chicken Lettuce Wraps with Peanut Sauce
steps: Whisk peanut butter, brown sugar, soy sauce, lemon juice, 1 tsp chili garlic sauce, and 1 tsp grated ginger with a little water until pourable
Chop the vegetables; julienne the carrot
Heat both oils in a large skillet over medium-high; sauté onion until translucent
Add chicken, break it up, and cook 5 min
Add mushrooms, carrot, remaining ginger, and garlic; cook 5 min
Stir in hoisin and remaining chili garlic sauce; cook until chicken is done; mix in cilantro and green onions
Spoon filling into lettuce leaves and drizzle with peanut sauce

recipes.name: 4-Ingredient Pesto Chicken Bake
steps: Heat oven to 375°F
Pound chicken to an even thickness (about 0.8 in); season with salt and pepper
Drain pesto in a fine mesh strainer, pressing out the excess oil
Place chicken in a baking dish and spread each piece with pesto
Top with mozzarella pearls and a tomato slice
Bake 25–30 min until chicken reaches 165°F; broil 1–2 min at the end if you like
Plate the chicken; drizzle with balsamic glaze if desired

recipes.name: Chorizo-Potato Tacos
steps: Microwave potato chunks with ½ cup water and a pinch of salt, covered, 5 min
Brown diced squash in oil over high heat 3–4 min; season and set aside
Cook chorizo in the same skillet, breaking it up, about 5 min
Add potatoes and their water; toss 5–6 min until browned and chorizo is cooked through
Mix tomatoes, scallion, jalapeño, cilantro, and salt for a quick salsa
Warm tortillas in a dry skillet
Fill with squash and chorizo mixture; top with cheese and salsa (sour cream or guacamole optional)

recipes.name: Thai Red Curry Noodle Soup
steps: Heat oil in a large pot over medium heat; season chicken chunks and brown 2–3 min; set aside
Cook garlic, bell pepper, and onion 3–4 min until tender
Stir in curry paste and ginger for about 1 min until fragrant
Pour in broth and coconut milk, scraping up the browned bits
Return chicken; bring to a boil, then simmer about 10 min until slightly reduced
Stir in rice noodles, fish sauce, and brown sugar; cook about 5 min until noodles are tender
Off the heat, stir in green onions, cilantro, basil, and lime juice; season to taste
Serve right away (store leftover noodles and broth separately)

recipes.name: Green Thai Chicken Coconut Curry
steps: Sauté diced onion in oil over medium-high heat about 5 min until soft
Add diced chicken; cook about 5 min until done, stirring often
Add garlic, ginger, and coriander; cook about 1 min until fragrant
Stir in coconut milk, carrots, zucchini, curry paste, salt, and pepper
Reduce heat to medium and gently boil about 5 min until reduced and slightly thickened
Stir in lime juice and cilantro; taste and adjust seasoning (a little sugar or extra paste if you like)
Serve over rice or with naan

recipes.name: Instant Pot Coconut Chicken
steps: In an Instant Pot, combine chopped onion, smashed garlic, soy sauce, ¼ of the vinegar, an equal amount of water, most of the sugar, and ½ tsp pepper; stir in chicken
Seal and cook on high pressure 8 min
Meanwhile, slice cucumbers and finely chop the chile; toss with the remaining vinegar and sugar and a good pinch of salt; let sit
Cook the rice as the package directs
Release the pressure manually and open the lid
Switch to high sauté and simmer 12–15 min until the sauce thickens slightly (a smaller batch may need less time)
Stir in the coconut cream
Serve chicken over rice with the cucumber salad

recipes.name: Instant Pot Creamy Goat Cheese Pasta
steps: Add penne, cherry tomatoes, broth, olive oil, oregano, pepper flakes, sliced garlic, and 2 tsp salt to the Instant Pot; stir (it’s fine if not everything is submerged)
Set the goat cheese log on top in the center
Lock the lid and pressure cook on high 5 min
Quick release the pressure, then carefully open the lid
Stir until the tomatoes are crushed and the cheese melts into the sauce
Spoon into bowls and top with chopped basil

recipes.name: Instant Pot Chicken Bryan
steps: Put chicken in the Instant Pot; drizzle with 2 tbsp oil from the sun-dried tomato jar and set the tomatoes aside
Add Italian seasoning, garlic powder, basil, lemon juice, broth, and butter; lightly salt and pepper
Seal and pressure cook 2 min (fresh or frozen chicken)
Let the pressure release naturally 5–10 min, then vent and open the lid
Stir cornstarch and milk into a smooth slurry; switch to sauté and stir it in; the sauce thickens quickly, then turn off
Drain, rinse, and coarsely chop the tomatoes; stir them in
Serve chicken and sauce topped with a big dollop of goat cheese

recipes.name: Chicken Shawarma Bowls
steps: Mix 1 tbsp oil with paprika, coriander, salt, cumin, turmeric, cayenne, cinnamon, and black pepper; toss with chicken and marinate 30 min at room temperature (or up to 3 hours in the fridge)
Simmer rice with a pinch of salt and 2 cups water, covered, on low about 15 min; rest covered 10 min; fluff
Cook chicken in 1 tbsp hot oil over medium-high, turning, until golden and 165°F inside, about 5–7 min per side (in batches if needed)
Rest chicken 10 min, then slice into thin strips
Toss cucumbers, bell peppers, red onion, tomatoes, and feta with pepper flakes, juice of 1 lemon, and the remaining 2 tsp oil; salt to taste
Stir yogurt with dill and the juice of the other lemon
Divide rice among bowls; top with chicken, veggies, yogurt sauce, and hummus; serve with warm pita

recipes.name: Slow-Cooker Tuscan Chicken Meatballs With Gnocchi
steps: Mix chicken, panko, egg, Italian seasoning, salt, pepper, garlic powder, half the tomatoes, and about half the Parmesan by hand; roll into 1-inch meatballs
In the slow cooker, combine chopped onion, garlic, broth, wine, a splash of oil from the tomato jar, and a pinch of salt; nestle in the meatballs
Cover and cook on high about 4 hours until the meatballs are cooked through
Heat the broiler with a rack in the upper third; move meatballs to a foil-lined baking sheet with a slotted spoon
Stir gnocchi and the remaining tomatoes into the slow cooker; cover and cook on high about 20 min until tender
Meanwhile, broil meatballs 6–8 min, turning halfway, until golden in spots
Stir in spinach, cream, and the remaining Parmesan; return the meatballs; cover and cook about 5 min until spinach wilts
Serve in bowls with extra Parmesan
